arguments.name: gnDivisionCode
arguments.description: The unique code of the GN Division to search for (e.g., '000001'). Performs exact match search. Either gnDivisionCode or gnDivisionName must be provided.

raw.name: gnDivisionCode
raw.description: The unique code of the GN Division to search for (e.g., '000001'). Performs exact match search. Either gnDivisionCode or gnDivisionName must be provided.

arguments.name: gnDivisionName
arguments.description: The name of the GN Division to search for (e.g., 'Warahanthuduwa'). Performs partial, case-insensitive match search. Either gnDivisionCode or gnDivisionName must be provided.

raw.name: gnDivisionName
raw.description: The name of the GN Division to search for (e.g., 'Warahanthuduwa'). Performs partial, case-insensitive match search. Either gnDivisionCode or gnDivisionName must be provided.

arguments.name: fetchDetails
arguments.description: Controls whether to fetch detailed information when only one result is found. Set to 'no' to skip detailed fetch and return only basic search results. Default behavior fetches details, including dsDivisionCode.

raw.name: fetchDetails
raw.description: Controls whether to fetch detailed information when only one result is found. Set to 'no' to skip detailed fetch and return only basic search results. Default behavior fetches details, including dsDivisionCode.

arguments.name: dsDivisionName
arguments.description: DS Division name (partial match, case-insensitive). Uses criteria value D.DSDIV_NAME. (optional)

raw.name: dsDivisionName
raw.description: DS Division name (partial match, case-insensitive). Uses criteria value D.DSDIV_NAME. (optional)

arguments.name: returnAll
arguments.description:
"yes" to return all GN Divisions (clicks Show All).
Also auto-triggers if any provided search value equals: "all", "available", "existing", "list", "show all".

raw.name: returnAll
raw.description:
"yes" to return all GN Divisions (clicks Show All).
Also auto-triggers if any provided search value equals: "all", "available", "existing", "list", "show all".
